issues.failure_explanation: A Bernoulli diagonal matrix has a random number of nonzero rows, not exactly m or each prescribed m_i. A single B also has only one success probability, so it cannot simultaneously supply matrices consisting of exactly m_i nonzero rows for all increasing sizes. The required joint law and nesting of the B_i are therefore undefined, and the fixed-size SRHT embedding theorem cannot directly be applied to this construction.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the Bernoulli-row description by a precise fixed-cardinality nested sampling scheme, such as taking the first m_i rows under one random permutation, and verify or cite the embedding guarantee for that joint construction.
